name: 所在が分からない人への通知方法を変更
summary: 不利益処分を受ける予定の人の所在が分からない場合、現在は市の掲示場への掲示で通知します。議案では、公示内容を不特定多数が見られる状態にし、市の掲示場への掲示または行政庁の事務所にある電子計算機で閲覧できるようにします。公示の措置を始めて2週間が過ぎると、通知が届いたものとみなします。
changes: 公示内容を規則などで定める方法により不特定多数が閲覧できる状態にする
公示事項を市の掲示場に掲示するか、行政庁の事務所にある電子計算機で閲覧できるようにする
公示の措置を始めて2週間後に通知が到達したものとみなす
who: 不利益処分を受ける予定で、所在が分からない人
why: 所在が分からない場合に公示で通知できるようにし、公示の方法を定めるためと、市は説明しています。

en.name: Changes the notification method for people whose whereabouts are unknown
en.official: Regarding the Enactment of an Ordinance Partially Amending the Kawasaki City Administrative Procedure Ordinance
en.summary: Currently, when the whereabouts of someone who is due to receive an adverse disposition are unknown, the city gives notice by posting it on the city's notice board. Under the bill, the contents of the public notice will be made viewable by an unspecified number of people, either by posting it on the city's notice board or by making it viewable on a computer at the administrative agency's office. The notice will be deemed to have been delivered 2 weeks after the public-notice measures begin.
changes: Make the contents of the public notice viewable by an unspecified number of people using methods prescribed by rules, etc.
Post the matters to be announced on the city's notice board or make them viewable on a computer at the administrative agency's office
Deem the notice to have been delivered 2 weeks after the public-notice measures begin
who: People who are due to receive an adverse disposition and whose whereabouts are unknown
en.why: The city says this is to allow notice to be given by public notice when someone's whereabouts are unknown and to set out the methods for giving public notice.
